summary: ATS Corp (ATS) filed a Form 6-K press release reporting Q4 FY2026 results. The CEO stated the company took decisive steps to restructure and reposition transportation-related businesses, consolidating operations, right-sizing facility footprint, and repositioning engineering/automation capabilities. No specific terms such as stake, price, premium, or advisors were provided. The restructuring is operational, aimed at improving cost structure, margin expansion, and free cash flow. As a Canadian filer using 6-K, this maps to a US voluntary restructuring disclosure. Watch for progress on reorganization initiatives and financial flexibility in upcoming quarters.
